about: AI Denoise's benchmark (INF-14, DN-17): DN-11's synthetic scenes with exact truth, the RawNIND pairs DN-17 scored, and CC0 raws from raw.pixls.us at ISO 3200 or higher. Synthetic cases are made by make_benchmark.py; trainedOn says which models trained on a RawNIND scene.
